packages.semantics: QA private OAUTH_KV facets are outer calls; M actual OAUTH_KV and QA existing fixture bottom calls are native by captured pair; same native Promise
existing local SSE body adapters over transport.handleRequest response; captured original request transport scope; two actual API read/cancel layers, not outbound fetch calls
classifyEntryRequest and WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport request consumers; local SSE producer; legacy fallback adapter is dormant under Agents legacy stateless lane
fixed remote-JWKS helper; expected installed source metadata/hash required at preflight; opaque JSON bytes

runtimeShape.call: observe the original receiver/function pair; invoke once via the original call form; return the identical native Promise/value/error
runtimeShape.identity: weak maps only; namespaces/session/statements/transactions/Response/stream/reader/clone; no new env proxy or method replacement
runtimeShape.body: tag fulfilled fetch Response only; observe actual body/getReader/clone accesses; no eager getter/read; each actual read/cancel has its own row; bytes only on read
runtimeShape.callback: capture actual immutable Root/child/phase at body reader acquisition; use that capture for later original reader calls/settlement, without replacing stream callbacks or using mutable current phase
runtimeShape.scope: ALS run/getStore only, exact Source lease/deadline acquisition; explicit fixture exclusions; missing unproven business context is incomplete
runtimeShape.limits: 16384 cap unchanged; all unknown/overflow/foreign association/selector mismatch fails qualification before acceptance; never changes Source guards or calls

entry.stage: after existing literal fixture composition, before new observation edits
entry.disposition: normal existing wrapper native leaves; named seed/config/probe RPCs excluded; negative branches dormant

preparedHashRule: Recorded QA hashes refer to e8 compile-only evidence. Existing approval/identity literals vary through the unmodified fixture; final preflight records actual pre-hook hashes and validates composition markers/counts. M uses raw source hashes, never QA overrides.
